name: Game switch: panel pass
when: The footage changes game: the cut from GTA VI footage to another game's footage (San Andreas, GTA IV, Red Dead 2), and the cut back to GTA VI after it (owner, 17 Nov 2026: never a direct cut between two games). One in and one out per run of another game's shots, the same variant both ways (series). The incoming game's logo (on the way back: the GTA VI logo) comes from assets/logos/ through `game`; a logo is never drawn or invented. The panel pass is the plainest of the three: a sunset panel sweeps across with the logo and the year on it.
anchor: Mount it over the project's own hard cut between the two games' shots: start the scene `cut` (0.4 s) before the cut. The panel is shut on the cut, holds the logo, and leaves at `out`; the scene ends 0.33 s later on the new footage.
placement: Keep the project's footage as a plain hard cut (the outgoing game's shot until the cut, the incoming game's shot from it). Mount the scene above both with make_scene --start <cut - 0.4>. The incoming shot plays under the panel and is uncovered as the panel leaves. Then show the game with a game tag (gametag) over its shots, starting as the panel leaves.

vars.theme: clean (deep coral panel, white year) or vice (sunset panel, ink year): the video's theme
vars.plate: clean theme only: the panel's colour, the same as the video's ground: coral (default, ground-B), night (ground-F) or late (ground-G). The vice panel is the sunset, whatever the ground
vars.game: the incoming game, as logos.json names it (going back: Grand Theft Auto VI)
vars.logo: its logo file: filled from assets/logos/ by build_video.mjs when `game` is listed there
vars.logo_cx: the logo's visual centre in logo widths from its image centre (+ = right), so the year centres on the artwork, not on the image box (owner, 17 Nov 2026: the 2026 looked off-centre under the GTA VI logo). build_video.mjs fills it from assets/logos/logos.json (cx); calling make_scene yourself, pass that cx (GTA VI 0.091)
vars.year: its release year (2004), shown under the logo; empty = none
vars.width: the logo's width in px: 760 for a wide wordmark, about 520 for a squarer logo
vars.cut: seconds after the start: the hard cut under the panel (0.4)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the panel leaves (default 1.2, so the logo holds about 0.8 s)

source: new, built in the skills repo (owner, 17 Nov 2026)
